candidates.source_name: Kosovo Banking Association (Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës) — News & events feed
candidates.why_relevant: The KBA is the convening body for Kosovo's banking sector. Its news feed publishes roundtable, conference and award write-ups that name individuals with exact current title and employer (e.g. CEO Petrit Balija; IFC country officer; visiting association presidents). Dated, self-published, precise — an authoritative weak signal for leadership moves and for which institutions are staffing up.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of /news/ listing pages; extract person-name + title + org triples from article bodies and photo captions; diff against prior roster snapshot.
candidates.discovered_via_method: keyword search sq+en, then snowball from association homepage
queries_used: Kosovo banking association conference speakers 2026 Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës
"Kosovo Banking Association" trajnime akademia bankare certifikim programe trajnimi bankierë

candidates.source_name: KBA Banking Training Centre — training catalogue (Trainings)
candidates.why_relevant: Course catalogue of the accredited KBA training centre (first in region to offer the European Foundation Certificate in Banking, EFCB). Course topics and scheduling reveal where banks are building capability (blockchain, financial crime/fraud & cyber, sanctions, capital markets, private banking) — a leading indicator of new roles and reorganised units. Trainer bios also name serving bank managers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the paginated trainings listing (note legacy path /En/trajnimet/?faqe=N also exists); track course additions/removals per quarter as a skills-demand signal.
candidates.discovered_via_method: keyword search sq, snowball from association site
queries_used: "Kosovo Banking Association" trajnime akademia bankare certifikim programe trajnimi bankierë

candidates.source_name: Kosova Finance Forum / Kosova Business Forum — speakers roster
candidates.why_relevant: The single richest speaker-bio source in the cell: KFF advertises 50+ regional and international financial-sector speakers per edition, each listed with photo, exact job title and institution, on a dated page. Ideal for detecting new CxO/deputy-governor/head-of-digital appointments and for building the actor map of Kosovo banking leadership.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual/edition-based scrape of /speaker/ and /sq/speaker-2/ plus edition archive pages (e.g. /kff25/); store name+title+org+edition-date as a titled-person timeseries and diff year-over-year.
candidates.discovered_via_method: keyword search sq then en; snowball from Telegrafi event preview
queries_used: konferenca bankare fintech Prishtinë folësit panel drejtues bankë
Kosova Finance Forum speakers agenda kosovafinanceforum.com

candidates.source_name: Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo (BQK) — conference agendas and news
candidates.why_relevant: BQK publishes full agendas (PDF/HTML) for its annual and anniversary conferences, listing every panellist with title. Agendas are the most precise dated title statements available for regulators and bank executives, and BQK news items also record who represents the CBK abroad — useful for tracking deputy-governor and directorate reshuffles.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl bqk-kos.org news (sq and ?lang=en variants) filtering for 'konferenc', 'agjenda', 'panel'; download attached agenda PDFs and parse speaker lines.
candidates.discovered_via_method: keyword search sq; snowball from KFF coverage
queries_used: BQK Banka Qendrore Kosovës konferenca vjetore trajnime folësit agjenda
local_language_terms_used: Banka Qendrore e Republikës së Kosovës

candidates.source_name: BQK — Trainings and seminars page (currency/banking operations)
candidates.why_relevant: Regulator-run training programmes for bank staff (cash handling, counterfeit detection, donor-funded technical training). Attendance requirements and new programme launches indicate compliance-driven headcount and unit changes at the banks that must send staff.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency page-diff monitoring (quarterly) on both sq and en variants.
candidates.discovered_via_method: keyword search sq, site navigation snowball
queries_used: BQK Banka Qendrore Kosovës konferenca vjetore trajnime folësit agjenda

candidates.source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo — RISE internship & scholarship programme news
candidates.why_relevant: RISE is an explicit university-to-bank pipeline (scholarships + internships for technology/IT students, ~15 per cohort, agile-methodology training). Cohort size and disciplines are a direct, dated signal of planned IT/digital headcount growth at one of Kosovo's largest banks.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor /shq/lajmi/ news index for 'RISE', 'praktikë', 'bursë'; record cohort size, disciplines, partner universities per year.
candidates.discovered_via_method: keyword search sq (internship terms)
queries_used: praktikë studentore bankë Kosovë program praktikantë "internship" ProCredit Raiffeisen TEB Kosovë

candidates.source_name: ProCredit Bank Kosova — careers / "How to join ProCredit" and Onboarding Programme
candidates.why_relevant: ProCredit runs a structured graduate entry route (Onboarding Programme, group training academy) plus mandatory-curriculum student internships of 1-3 months. Openings and cohort announcements are a clean planned-headcount signal; the group-wide HR portal adds a second, comparable feed.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll careers page + hr.procredit-group.com internship page monthly; capture location lists (branch towns) as a geographic expansion signal.
candidates.discovered_via_method: keyword search sq+en; snowball to group HR portal and to KosovaJob employer page

candidates.source_name: KosovaJob — bank employer pages (internship / employment programme listings)
candidates.why_relevant: Kosovo's dominant job board carries per-employer pages where banks post internship, summer-internship and graduate-programme calls that sometimes never appear on the bank's own site. Acts as an aggregator/archive for the university pipeline half of this cell.

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Per-employer page polling for the licensed bank list (BQK licence list as the seed of employer slugs); filter titles for 'praktikant', 'internship', 'trainee', 'programi'.

candidates.source_name: STIKK (Kosovo ICT Association) — KosICT festival and events archive
candidates.why_relevant: KosICT is Kosovo's largest tech event (Tech Park Prishtina; 3,000+ attendees, ~30 speakers incl. international). Banks' digital/IT leaders and fintech founders appear as speakers and sponsors, giving dated title statements for the technology side of banking leadership that never surface in banking-press coverage.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /en/category/events/ and /en/category/news/ plus the per-edition KosICT microsite speaker pages; extract speaker cards.

candidates.source_name: The Banker (FT) — Bank of the Year Awards, Kosovo country winner
candidates.why_relevant: Annual country award. Award citations and the bank's own press release quote the accepting executive by name and title, and the citation text describes strategy shifts (new card offering, sustainability programme) that precede reorganisations. The winner's press release is often more accessible than The Banker's paywalled page.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual sweep each Nov/Dec of thebanker.com Bank of the Year country list, cross-collected from the winning bank's own newsroom in sq/en.
candidates.discovered_via_method: keyword search sq+en on award terms

candidates.why_relevant: Publishes a Kosovo-specific national winners page annually (Awards for Excellence and Private Banking Awards). Citations describe the winning bank's business lines and often name the executives behind them — a dated, third-party-verified statement of who runs what.

candidates.why_relevant: The official UP unit that brokers internships and employer relations for Kosovo's largest university (est. 2007). negative_findings.description: No Kosovo-specific banking/fintech AWARDS programme (a domestic 'Banka e Vitit' / 'Menaxheri i Vitit' scheme run inside Kosovo) was found. Searches in sq for 'çmimi banka e vitit Kosovë' and 'menaxheri i vitit' returned only international award programmes (The Banker, Euromoney, Stevie) naming Kosovo as a country category.
negative_findings.result_summary: Kosovo banking awards appear to be exclusively foreign-conferred; the domestic award layer, if any, is invisible to search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Award citations are a core weak signal for this cell. If no domestic scheme exists, coverage must lean entirely on foreign award pages (some paywalled) plus the winning bank's own press release, which reduces both volume and independence of the signal.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr) searching for banking conferences, speaker rosters and bank internships in Kosovo produced almost nothing Kosovo-specific. Queries on Kosovska Mitrovica / Ekonomski fakultet / bankarstvo returned Serbia-wide or unrelated academic material; no sr-language banking conference in or about Kosovo was identified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only one usable sr source surfaced (AIK Banka scholarships for students in Kosovo and Metohija) plus an unofficial directory pointer to the Faculty of Economics in Kosovska Mitrovica.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The Serb-majority north is a real segment of Kosovo's banking labour market and its institutions publish in Serbian only. Without sr sources, leadership and hiring signals from that segment will be systematically missing.

negative_findings.description: No internship, trainee or graduate-programme page was found for TEB Sh.a. Kosovo, BKT Kosova or NLB Banka Kosovo despite targeted sq+en queries. Only the corporate sites and a group-level NLB careers page surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Three of the largest Kosovo banks have no discoverable university-pipeline programme via search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Either these programmes exist but are published only on login-gated ATS portals / job boards / social media, or they genuinely do not run them. The distinction matters for interpreting 'no internship signal' from these banks as evidence of flat headcount plans.

negative_findings.description: The Kosova Finance Forum / Kosova Business Forum speaker pages (/speaker/ and sq /speaker-2/) were identified via search snippets but their per-edition structure, archive depth and whether past-edition rosters remain online were not established in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: High-value source located; retention and archiving behaviour unknown.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If the organiser overwrites the speaker page each edition, historical title snapshots are lost and the source must be captured live each year (plus a web-archive fallback) rather than mined retrospectively.

negative_findings.description: No Kosovo-specific FINTECH conference (as distinct from general finance forums and the general-purpose KosICT technology festival) was identified. Searches in sq and en for fintech conferences in Prishtina returned Albania-based events (Bank of Albania digital banking conference, AAB) or generic tech events.
negative_findings.result_summary: The fintech-event layer for Kosovo appears to be absorbed into KFF panels and KosICT tracks rather than existing as a standalone event.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Speaker rosters for payments/fintech leadership must be extracted from panel-level detail inside broader events, which is harder to automate than a dedicated fintech-conference speaker page.

negative_findings.description: Two of the most information-dense channels for speaker/award-adjacent title data are collection-restricted: LinkedIn company and personal pages (login wall plus ToS prohibition on scraping) and Euromoney award articles (subscription paywall).
negative_findings.result_summary: Both recorded as blocked candidates rather than dropped.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collection design that assumes LinkedIn scraping will fail legally and technically; the pipeline must route these through analyst review or licensed access and treat the open-web mirrors (association site, winning bank press release) as the collectable substitute.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language coverage of banking events, training and university pipeline inside Kosovo is nearly absent from this slice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sr-only pass targeting: the official domain of Ekonomski fakultet Univerziteta u Prištini (Kosovska Mitrovica), Kosovo-north Serbian-language news outlets (KoSSev, Radio Kim, Gracanicaonline), and Serbian banks operating branches/services in the north; also search 'stručna praksa', 'konkurs za stipendije', 'gostujuće predavanje banka'.

coverage_gaps.description: Per-bank event/careers pages were only established for Raiffeisen and ProCredit. TEB, BKT Kosova, NLB Banka, Banka Ekonomike, BPB and the payment institutions have no enumerated internship/graduate/event source in this slice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use the BQK licensed-institutions PDF as the seed list and systematically enumerate each institution's /karriera, /lajme and /media pages in sq and en, plus their KosovaJob employer page.

coverage_gaps.description: Private and non-public universities with strong bank ties — UBT College, RIT Kosovo (A.U.K.), Riinvest College, AAB, European College of Kosovo — were not individually covered, despite being the likeliest hosts of bank-sponsored career fairs, guest lectures and graduate schemes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a per-institution pass on career-centre and news pages for 'panair i punës', 'praktikë', 'memorandum bashkëpunimi' + bank names; RIT Kosovo and Riinvest in particular publish English-language employer partnership news.

coverage_gaps.description: Speaker rosters and agendas are ephemeral: organiser sites typically replace them per edition, and no archival strategy is yet defined for this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a Wayback Machine (web.archive.org) snapshot-and-retrieval step for kosovabusinessforum.com/speaker/, bqk-kos.org agenda pages and KosICT speaker microsites, and trigger a live capture in the two weeks before and after each known event date.

coverage_gaps.description: Donor and IFI training/capacity-building programmes (EBRD Women in Business, IFC advisory, GIZ, Deutsche Sparkassenstiftung, EU Office in Kosovo traineeships) touch this cell — they fund bank training and internship schemes and their press releases name bank counterparts — but were only glimpsed indirectly.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout ebrd.com, ifc.org, giz.de/kosovo, sparkassenstiftung.de and eeas.europa.eu/kosovo project and press pages for Kosovo banking-sector training and internship projects; the KBA–Deutsche Sparkassenstiftung MoU (March 2026) is a confirmed entry point.

coverage_gaps.description: Several candidate URLs in this slice are constructed or inferred from search snippets (e.g. the KBA /trainings/ index, amchamksv.org events path) rather than fetched, and one Serbian-language entry is a third-party directory standing in for an unlocated official domain.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Route all candidates through the deterministic liveness pass; for any 404, resolve the correct path by crawling the site root rather than marking the source dead.

brief: Kosovo's banking events-and-pipeline source landscape is small, highly centralised and Albanian-language dominant: three convenors — the Kosovo Banking Association (news feed, accredited EFCB training centre, Global Money Week/SML student competition), the Central Bank BQK (annual conference agendas with full panellist lists, plus its own training programmes), and the Kosova Finance Forum (50+ speaker roster per edition) — account for most dated, precise title-and-employer statements available in this cell, with STIKK/KosICT and AmCham Kosovo covering the technology and business-chamber flanks. The university pipeline is visible mainly through two banks that publish it well (Raiffeisen's RISE scholarship-and-internship scheme for IT students, ProCredit's Onboarding Programme and curricular internships), amplified by the KosovaJob board and the University of Prishtina Career Development Centre; the other large banks (TEB, BKT, NLB) show no discoverable graduate scheme, which is itself a finding to test rather than accept. Awards are entirely foreign-conferred (The Banker, Euromoney, Stevie, Albanian ICT Awards) with no domestic 'bank of the year' scheme found, so award citations must usually be collected from the winning bank's own press release because the originating pages are paywalled. The dominant weakness is Serbian-language coverage — a dedicated sr pass on northern Kosovo institutions and media is required before this cell can be considered complete.
